entities.name: Castries Fires and Urban Development
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The capital Castries suffered devastating fires in 1796, 1812, 1813, and 1948, each time being rebuilt. These repeated destructions shaped the city's architecture and urban development, with few colonial-era buildings surviving into the modern period.
